title: Malaysian Pasta Feta Delight
description: A simple and flavorful dish that combines the creaminess of feta with the spices of Malaysia. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a quick lunch.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, combine peanut sauce, soy sauce, sugar, ginger, and sesame oil. Blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, combine cooked pasta and peanut sauce mixture. Toss until pasta is well coated.
Crumble feta cheese over the pasta and toss until combined.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro and crushed peanuts over the top.
